### What's Going Wrong

You are running **Hermes Agent v0.14.0**, which routes `ollama-cloud` requests to `https://ollama.com/api`, resulting in an `HTTP 404` error.

### Solution

This issue was resolved in **v0.15.0 (`v2026.5.28`)**, where the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider was updated to route directly to `https://ollama.com/v1` instead of `/api`.

To fix the issue, update your Hermes installation:

```powershell
hermes update
```

After updating to v0.15.0 or newer, requests to Ollama Cloud will use the correct endpoint (`https://ollama.com/v1`) and connect properly.
